node.title: Re: Installing Curses module under Win32
node.author: rodinski
node.doctext: Did you ever get this to work? I'm having the exactly the same issue. I would like to spends some time on a solution that uses Curses::UI and be able to compile (or pack) it for a Windows 10 machine. I too have gotten demos of PDCurses to run on Windows but have not been able to get Curses:UI to build. I have Strawberry Perl on said Windows machine.
